source_steps: Each native sequence is matched with exact operator, input/output shapes and dtypes from archived CPU-stack templates. Select after the preceding sampler tail and before the next active external target lookup. Positive 38-task and 17-task matches identify the live compressed C2 and ratio-one writes. A raw slot-launch marker was not mandatory. Signatures identify writer work but do not expose addresses, alias safety, or permission to defer an intervening fallback.

C8 incremental scenarios apply only to ten graph waves with a B1/B2/B3 DP. The B4 side keeps its previously accepted implementation. Two full waves verify the native-chain reference. At each TP8 external SUM and first EP16 expert entry assume preserved service duration/relative downstream timing and propagate the shift in the maximum participant start. Clock differences are bounded per wave from 40 F21 groups and four previously matched input collectives per DP. The zero-offset reference can lie outside the bounded columns when the actual collective constraints exclude zero offset. Per-cut bounds can use different clocks; host scheduling and a noncritical queue can absorb the advance.

The 26-writer gain is a B4 paired whole-caller native median. Half and equal 13-writer savings are assumptions. Old slot-kernel durations and the 112 samples of fused coordinate/flat tasks price within-writer device changes separately; the reference cohort has different service configuration. No sum of independent fused-kernel or service percentages. Do not multiply individual card credits by 16.

For each ordinary request the serving DP has one active request. Existing observed B1 frozen groups supply three readiness examples, including the two DPs in a single wave; not ordinary request timings. TP8 gap formula applies before the other DP and client dependencies. Eager, packed, cache hit, no output, skipped, dummy, noncontiguous and alias-conflicting paths are separate.
